properties.description: cargo test -p reflow2-core --no-default-features --test in_memory the_server_stamps_each_node_creation_and_content_change. A new node is stamped created and changed now and reads recorded here; every read (get_node, scan_nodes, the write's own reply) carries no stamp; rewriting identical content moves nothing and a change keeps the creation; a write naming any stamp is refused and writes nothing, also through create_nodes; a caller-typed created_at is content, never a stamp; export_graph_with_stamps carries them (in properties on disk, held apart in memory) and the same store vouches for them on return; another store reads them imported, re-exports them unchanged, and drops an imported creation on a change rather than sealing it; an edited content or a backdated time in a document is never vouched for; a node no stamp was recorded for reads not recorded; a plain export carries none, so two designs built apart export identically.
